messages.content:
You are a cybersecurity social media manager for 'Cyber Range Labs'.

Given the article below, return ONLY a raw JSON object — no markdown, no explanation.

Article Title: {{ $json.title }}
Article Description: {{ $json.desc }}

Return this exact JSON:
{
  "template": <1=critical CVE/breach/exploit, 2=patch/news/update, 3=guide/tips/how-to>,
  "headline": "<tweaked title, UPPERCASE, max 40 chars per line, use \\n to split if needed>",
  "badge": "<one of: CRITICAL CVE | SECURITY UPDATE | DATA BREACH | MALWARE ALERT | SECURITY GUIDE | THREAT INTEL>",
  "pills": ["<tag1>","<tag2>","<tag3 optional>"],
  "body": "<1-2 sentence expansion for template 2, else empty string>",
  "description": "<2-3 sentences for template 3, else empty string>",
  "caption": "<2-3 sentence engaging summary>\n\n<6-8 hashtags starting with #CyberRangeLabs>"
}

Rules:
- headline must be UPPERCASE and slightly different from the original title (change 2-3 words)
- for CVE use pills like [\"CVE-XXXX-XXXX\",\"CVSS: X.X\",\"PLATFORM\"]
- caption: paragraph then blank line then hashtags all on one line
